description: Review operational events without searching unrelated output. Keep named notice, warning and alert logs, and forward matching new entries. Start with list or read; each severity has its own bounded history.
author: Serg Parf

write.help: Keep one event and forward it to matching subscriptions. Matching sends finish before the reply.

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

args.name: text
args.help: One line, cleaned of controls and cut to 200 characters

read.help: Review retained events, newest first. Without a severity, show alert, warning and notice histories in that order.

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

read.returns: {log,rings:{alert:[],warning:[],notice:[]},counts:{alert:n,warning:n,notice:n},latest_alert_at,now}; selected rings only, counts all levels; latest_alert_at null when no live alert

list.help: Find active logs, their entry counts and their latest retained alert time. Names are sorted.

pull.help: Take the oldest events out of a log and return them. Copies already sent to subscription destinations are unchanged.

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

pull.returns: {log,entries:[],remaining,now}; oldest id first; removal durable before reply

clean.help: Delete events through an entry ID, or delete all selected events. Only deleting every severity without an ID boundary retires the log.

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

args.name: id
args.help: Inclusive entry upper id boundary; positive integer

sub.add.help: Receive matching new events from now on. In text, a single selector names a log, even if it is alert; JSON may select only a severity.

args.name: target
args.help: Destination queue or agent; creator grants checked at add and every send

args.name: log
args.help: Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters

args.name: filter
args.help: Portable bare or /pattern/imsu regex, at most 200 scalar characters

sub.list.help: Review your subscriptions. Direct Owners and Maintainers see all, including damaged rows marked invalid_state for repair.

sub.delete.help: Stop your subscription. Direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any subscription, including damaged rows.

args.name: id
args.help: Subscription id: exactly 12 lower-case hexadecimal characters

help.help: Find available methods and their limits.

status.help: Check health and the number of active logs in one line. Only direct readers, writers, Owners and Maintainers may use it.

rings.help: Level → optional size and ttl duration; defaults notice 200/1d, warning 200/7d, alert 50/30d; combined size <=500

logs.help: Log name → per-level ring overrides, same shape as rings
